translation_notes: Two Namespace(...) -> two @prefix; FOAF/RDF/RDFS/XSD references -> foaf:/rdf:/rdfs:/xsd:. `@graph g` makes g inherit the block's prefixes, so the three g.bind(...) lines disappear (city, dbpo and foaf stay bound, visible in the printed Turtle). Ten g.add((...)) -> one +{ } (the shared subject city:ernesto merged; the blank node stays {bnode}). name/year become "..."^^xsd:string and "..."^^xsd:gYear (constant lexical forms, so the string form is exact).

original.py (and translated.ldpy) differ from the extracted region by one fix applied identically: `.decode("utf-8")` after g.serialize(...) removed - rdflib >= 6 returns str, so the extracted region raised AttributeError before showing the graph. No RDF meaning.

The driver creates data/ (the region writes ./data/lab2_example_rdflib.ttl, the repository's own folder). It compares stdout (the Turtle text with prefix table), the file written (as a graph) and the return value; 6 mutants killed (typed-literal datatype, plain literal, namespace IRI, missing @graph, missing file).
